name: open-planner-studio
description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Open Planner Studio desktop app, so Claude can read and edit your open construction schedule.
long_description:
This extension connects Claude Desktop to the AI bridge of the Open Planner Studio desktop app on your own computer. It contains no planner of its own: the app must be running, with the AI bridge started on the AI tab. Claude then gets the planner_ tools of the app: read and change tasks, relations, resources, calendars and baselines, and calculate the schedule. Every change is one undo step in the app, and the app can pause the AI or allow reading only.

Paste the token from the app (AI tab › Connection › Connect) into the Token field. Change the port only if you changed it in the app.

token.title: Token
token.description: The token from Open Planner Studio: AI tab › Connection › Connect. It gives access to the open plan; do not share it.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port of the AI bridge in Open Planner Studio (AI tab › Connection › Port). Default 3877.
